meta_description: Save 10% on your first Z.ai GLM Coding Plan subscription. Find the latest discount offer, promo code details, eligibility and how to claim your savings.
introduction: Looking for a Z.ai discount, coupon code or promo code? Eligible first-time subscribers can get 10% off their first GLM Coding Plan subscription using Z.ai’s invitation offer. The discount is claimed through the offer link below rather than a separate checkout coupon.
offer_status: Published campaign; confirm availability at checkout
affiliate_disclosure: The website owner may receive Z.ai credits if you make an eligible purchase through the offer link. This is an independent guide, not an official Z.ai website.
steps: Open the discount link above, then sign in or register and complete the invitation flow on Z.ai.
Choose your first GLM Coding Plan subscription and review the order summary.
Check that the expected discount appears before paying. If it does not, ask Z.ai support before completing the order.
eligibility_conditions: New accounts and existing accounts with no paid subscription history can qualify, once per user.
Only the initial subscription qualifies; renewals, upgrades and downgrades are excluded.
Similar first-order promotions cannot be combined.
The final payment must be at least US$0.50; the discount may be adjusted to meet that minimum.

Bind the invitation by logging in through the event page. The rules specify a first subscription payment within 72 hours for the inviter to receive a reward; they do not explicitly describe this as the buyer discount’s expiry.
If several invitation links are used, the last valid touchpoint determines the inviter. Z.ai may change, suspend or end the campaign.
pricing_notes: Compare Lite, Pro and Max plans and billing periods on Z.ai, then check which offers apply to your chosen subscription at checkout.
For an eligible order, a 10% reduction means paying 90% of the qualifying amount, subject to the minimum payment rule. The discount applies to your first subscription, not future renewals.

faqs.question: Is there a Z.ai coupon code for 10% off?
faqs.answer: This guide describes an invitation offer, not a separate checkout coupon. The Z.ai invitation code NFCM2FGTQJ is included in the offer link; it is not verified as a standalone Z.ai discount code to enter at checkout.

faqs.question: How can I get a GLM Coding Plan discount?
faqs.answer: Use the offer link, complete the invitation flow and check the price of your first eligible subscription before paying. You do not need a separate checkout coupon for this offer.

faqs.question: Does Z.ai offer discounts for new subscribers?
faqs.answer: The published campaign provides 10% off an eligible first GLM Coding Plan subscription. Confirm the current offer and your account’s eligibility at checkout.

faqs.question: Can existing Z.ai users claim the discount?
faqs.answer: An existing account can qualify if it has never had a paid subscription. Having an account alone does not exclude you.

faqs.question: Does the Z.ai promo offer work on renewals?
faqs.answer: No. This first-order offer excludes renewals, upgrades and downgrades. It is not an API credit purchase discount.

faqs.question: Can I combine the discount with other offers?
faqs.answer: The campaign excludes combining similar first-order discounts. Compare the final payable price when choosing between Z.ai offers.

faqs.question: Why is my Z.ai discount not appearing?
faqs.answer: Check your payment history, any competing promotion and whether the invitation was bound to your account. Contact Z.ai support before paying if the expected price is missing.

faqs.question: When does the offer expire?
faqs.answer: The rules do not give a fixed campaign end date. Z.ai can change or end the offer; the verified date on this guide is a source-check date, not a guarantee of checkout availability.
